title: Conduct-Complaint Excusal Points, Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the conduct-complaint excusal points are the conduct excusal credit, capped at the points the disputed violation was recorded with. The conduct excusal credit is the counter-wait credit plus the praise credit, used as they stand whatever the shopper's tenure, less the prior-complaint reduction and less the standing-points reduction, never below zero, where the counter-wait credit, the praise credit, the prior-complaint reduction and the standing-points reduction are each zero points.

**The disputed violation.** The most recent conduct-complaint violation on the account; its recorded points are the points on that violation entry.

## Order of calculation

1. The counter-wait credit and the praise credit are added and used as they stand.
2. The prior-complaint reduction and the standing-points reduction are each subtracted once.
3. A negative figure counts as zero: this is the conduct excusal credit.
4. The credit is capped at the recorded points of the disputed violation; the excusal points are the lower of the two.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Counter-wait credit | 0 points |
| Praise credit | 0 points |
| Prior-complaint reduction | 0 points |
| Standing-points reduction | 0 points |

## Worked example (hypothetical violation)

The most recent conduct-complaint violation was recorded with 4 points. The credit is 0 plus 0, used as it stands, less 0 and less 0: 0 points, not below zero. The lower of 0 and 4 is 0, so the excusal points are 0.
